source_hash_closure: All seven current sources equal immutable rev002 snapshots and receipt. Generated receipts remain unchanged and passed; no candidate execution by reviewer. Root separately verifies all 127 dependencies.
fit_review: Explicit all-true bool mask covers every concatenated old FIT and newly collected row. Ordered old target mapping and typed new book provenance are retained as unit-weight multiset; no legacy prompt<nfit filter.

One shared C32 tree, full-H leaf means and normal P128 are rebuilt per layer on the complete union, with fixed inherited seeds/solvers/ties. Incomplete geometry holds the phase; no old/new geometry selection.

Canonical targets for each of the eight operators are queried once for every new common input row and shared by local and fixed-control fits. Old Y reuse requires the successful semantic-binding audit and its historical target hashes.

Original per-operator eta/lambda and full-H global eta transfer dimensionlessly; covariance, within-leaf actual decoded-A8 centering, pooled prior, trace-scaled penalties and local correction are recomputed on the union.
Fixed roles are PE_RRR for six and G_RRR for Deep L13 E10 and OLM L8 E9, q512 W8 host_floatlatent with identity gauge, no new grid or validation selection.
Mtarget and fixed eigenspace rules use the same shared targets; actual lowered-model predictions determine fresh F32 residual biases. No copied old bias, RMS or numerical beta arrays.
New archive loaders validate finite positive scales, finite biases/factors, shapes, metadata and unsupported IDs; archived model hashes are reconstructed and checked.
Real leaf occupancy, group counts and pooled/local rank/condition diagnostics are recorded. Unsupported regions retain explicit inherited canonical fallback; incomplete fit is not scientific failure.

Selected old/new rows and every leaf exercise archived B1-versus-batch equality; the refreshed Registry loads explicit new preprocessing via hash-bound manifest and checks local/factor IPC outputs with natural old FIT IDs.

Audit and collection file hashes are checked before and after fitting. New models, geometry, shared targets, provenance, registry, payload manifest and fixed future comparisons are frozen in the completion dependency list.
Unique output directory, preserved old inputs/models and phase-start guard enforce the one-refresh recipe; no model contexts or further states are generated during fitting.

generated_evidence.checks: Union inclusion/legacy negative control, preprocessing roundtrip, fixed PE/G penalties and conditioning, archives/B1-batch/actual bias, canonical target mismatch detection already passed.

required_before_actual_fit: Root independently verifies successful complete COLLECT_REFRESH and all its dependency hashes; this source review did not inspect collected payloads or outcomes.
Root issues a separate actual FIT approval binding exact BIND_OLD_CAPTURE complete SHA, COLLECT_REFRESH complete SHA and old_capture_files_sha256 mapping.
Preserve any numerical/provenance/fit failures as technical or inconclusive evidence; do not repair labels, exclude rows, expand grid or silently repeat refresh.
interpretation_limits: Old-label audit establishes current X -> frozen canonical Y, not historical input identity.
The finite union is not a convergence certificate and generated arms from a book are not independent books.
Offline fit/query cost and operator representation are not deployed speed, 8GB residency, full-model quality or all-family impossibility.
This source gate does not release PG validation payload/evaluation, QUALITY or TEST, and assigns no scientific outcome.
